**Mesh Mix-S2C 2.0.1** is a small update that keeps the app's update button working in the future.

## What changed

- **Update checks keep working if the project moves.** The project's GitHub organization is about to get a new name (Mesh-Mix-S2C). After a rename, GitHub still forwards web links, but not the address the app uses to look for updates, so 2.0.0 would stop finding new versions. 2.0.1 looks for updates by the project's permanent number on GitHub, which no rename changes, and by its name as a backup.

Nothing else changed: conversions, settings and files work exactly as in 2.0.0. See the [2.0.0 release notes](https://github.com/STL2CURVES-MMM/Mesh-Mix-S2C/releases/tag/v2.0.0) for everything that's new in 2.0.

**Please install this update** (the update button in the app, or the download below), so that your app keeps being offered future versions.

## Downloads

- **macOS 14+ (Apple silicon):** `MeshMix-S2C-2.0.1-macOS-arm64.zip`. Unzip it and drag the app into Applications. The first time, right-click it and choose **Open** (the app isn't notarized).
- **Windows 10/11 (64-bit):** `MeshMix-S2C-2.0.1-Windows-x64-Setup.exe`. If SmartScreen warns, click **More info → Run anyway**.
- **Linux (x86-64):** `MeshMix-S2C-2.0.1-Linux-x86_64.AppImage`. Make it executable and double-click it.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` has the checksums.

## Reporting a problem

Select the file in the queue and use **Save Report…**, then attach the report to a new issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/STL2CURVES-MMM/Mesh-Mix-S2C/issues).
